subject: Typography
label: WEBSITE TYPOGRAPHY
caption_ig:
If your website text is hard to read, visitors won't stay to figure out what you sell. 📱

Fix these 4 common typography mistakes today:
1. Body text smaller than 16px
2. Light gray text on white backgrounds
3. More than 2 font families
4. Text spanning the full screen width

Save this post and audit your homepage today!

#webdesign #smallbusiness #conversionrate #usability #websiteadvice
caption_fb: Most small business owners choose website fonts based on aesthetic preference, but hard-to-read text directly impacts your bottom line. When potential clients have to strain their eyes or lose their place reading your copy, they leave without inquiring. Ensuring your text is high contrast, set to at least 16px, and limited to two clean font families makes your website instantly easier to navigate. Take five minutes today to check your homepage on a mobile device in bright light—you might find a quick fix that keeps leads on your site longer.
caption_li:
Website typography is rarely viewed as a conversion issue, but poor readability quietly loses prospective clients.

When text lacks contrast, lines span too wide across desktop monitors, or body copy is sized below 16 pixels, reading becomes work. Most visitors will simply bounce rather than fight through bad formatting.

To ensure your message lands clearly:
- Keep body text at 16px or larger
- Stick to dark text on light backgrounds
- Limit your site to two font families
- Restrict text column widths on desktop

When reading requires zero effort, prospects spend more time evaluating your offer. Have you checked how your website reads on a mobile device recently?

slides.title: Decorative fonts are costing you homepage leads.
slides.body: If visitors cannot scan your services in three seconds because of a script or fancy font, they leave. Use clean, simple fonts so your offer and pricing are instantly clear on mobile.

slides.title: 1. Light gray text vanishes on mobile screens.
slides.body: Low contrast text strains the eyes, especially outdoors. If your copy is light gray on a white background, visitors give up trying to read your pitch. Switch to dark gray or black.

slides.title: 2. Using more than two fonts creates confusion.
slides.body: Mixing three or four typefaces makes your business look disorganized. Limit your site to two fonts: one for headings and one for main body copy. This guides eyes straight to your call-to-action.

slides.title: 3. Full-width desktop text lines kill readability.
slides.body: When text stretches across a wide screen, readers lose their place moving to the next line. Keep paragraph columns under 75 characters wide so visitors actually read your entire sales offer.

slides.title: A 4-step typography checklist for your website:
slides.body: 1. Body font size is 16px minimum. 2. High-contrast dark text on light background. 3. Max two font families used. 4. Text columns capped on desktop. Fix these to keep potential buyers reading.
